title: Meltdown Circuit Breaker & AAC
description: One-tap emergency browser sanctuary for acute sensory overload or non-verbal shutdowns. Instantly drops screen luminance, generates brown/pink noise via WebAudio DSP, runs paced visual breathing shaders, and provides full-screen high-contrast AAC communication cards for bystanders.
metrics: Sub-50ms sensory isolation & instant non-verbal communication

title: Hyperfocus State Machine
description: Deterministic finite-state automaton that models recursive engineering dependencies and protects deep-work sessions. Uses gentle peripheral chromatic shifts instead of jarring alarms to prevent time-blindness and guide smooth transitions to physiological breaks.
metrics: Zero context drop during 6-hour deep engineering sessions

title: Cognitive Load & Jargon Stripper
description: Client-side text processor that strips emotional fluff, passive-aggressive subtext, and corporate ambiguity from pasted emails, specs, or chat threads, restructuring them into clean, bulleted literal requirements.

title: Executive Dysfunction Micro-Slicer
description: Emergency tool for severe task paralysis. Takes a single overwhelming goal and uses a local graph solver to strip away everything except one atomic, 2-minute physical action, hiding the rest of the tree until momentum is established.

title: Psychoacoustic Environmental Masker
description: Real-time browser synthesizer written in C++20 compiled to AudioWorklet/WASM. Generates customizable colored noise, binaural focus frequencies, and dynamic notch filtering to mask unpredictable environmental frequencies (HVAC hum, traffic, voices).
metrics: Zero-latency custom spectral masking in browser

title: Deterministic Decision Matrix
description: Multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA) engine for moments when competing variables cause cognitive freeze. Applies weighted linear programming and strict elimination thresholds in WASM to output a mathematically optimal choice.
metrics: Resolves complex multi-variable choices in under 90 seconds

title: Interoception & Somatic Scanner
description: Structured daily bio-feedback check-in designed to counter alexithymia and poor interoceptive awareness. Maps subtle physical tension, jaw clenching, hydration, and fatigue signals onto a 3D anatomical body mesh to detect burnout 24 hours before onset.
metrics: Early detection of pre-meltdown somatic accumulation

title: Facial Action Coding (FACS) Trainer
description: Local-first Computer Vision trainer powered by PyTorch/ONNX in WebGPU. Analyzes facial landmarks and Action Units (AUs) in real time or on video datasets to practice decoding neurotypical micro-expressions without the exhaustion of live social masking.
metrics: 100% client-side CV inference, zero webcam data leaves browser

title: Vocal Prosody & Pitch Visualizer
description: Real-time FFT pitch-contour and cadence oscilloscope. Helps practice vocal modulation or decode neurotypical sarcasm and emotional subtext by visualizing fundamental frequency (F0) variance and speech rhythm patterns.
metrics: Real-time F0 pitch contour tracking at 60 FPS

title: Social Protocol & Script Sandbox
description: Interactive branching state-machine for rehearsing high-stakes interviews, salary negotiations, or medical appointments. Models conversational edge cases, unwritten etiquette rules, and pre-computes low-energy exit scripts.

title: Cognitive Spoon & Burnout Ledger
description: Quantitative energy telemetry system modeling sensory, social, and cognitive expenditure as thermodynamic budgets. Uses time-series forecasting to warn when upcoming calendar commitments exceed recovery capacity.
metrics: Predictive burnout modeling across 14-day rolling windows

title: Special Interest Spatial Graph
description: High-performance force-directed 3D knowledge engine built with C++20 spatial indexing and WebGL. Designed to ingest, link, and explore thousands of research papers, specs, and deep-dive notes without linear folder friction.
metrics: Renders 50,000+ interconnected nodes smoothly in browser
